SELECT l.*,md5(to_jsonb(l)::text) AS source_row_md5 FROM public.catalog_location_prices l
      WHERE l.store='carrefour' AND l.product_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.carrefour_products WHERE published IS TRUE AND (display_name ~* '(agua|aigua|water|yogu|yogh|iogur|patat|papat)' OR category_name ~* '(agua|aigua|water|yogu|yogh|iogur|patat|papat)|b[ií]fidus'))
      AND l.id COLLATE "C" > '' COLLATE "C" ORDER BY l.id COLLATE "C" LIMIT 200
